episodes.synopsis: Funny becomes obsessed with a picture of a handsome man, leaving Crescent and Corona without any food.
episodes.title: Love

episodes.synopsis: Crescent frees Horley from a bear trap, and his family comes to thank Crescent for his act of kindness. Unfortunately, their method of rewarding Crescent is much different than he expected.
episodes.title: Repayment of a Favor

episodes.synopsis: Corona becomes depressed after his frog friend gets run over by a circus truck. Crescent feels bad for him, and tries to bring the frog back to life.
episodes.title: Replay

episodes.synopsis: After she drinks an orange potion, the two halves of Funny's personality are unleashed. One good, and one evil. But Crescent quickly learns not to judge a book by its cover.
episodes.title: Evil and Just

episodes.synopsis: Crescent accidentally wets the bed, and tries to hide the evidence by any means necessary.
episodes.title: Hidden

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious masked figure stalks and harms various characters.
episodes.title: Treatment

episodes.synopsis: Crescent and Corona experience the most nightmare-inducing time of their lives.
episodes.title: Goldfish

episodes.synopsis: Funny manipulates Crescent into playing a dangerous game, that involves killing others.
episodes.title: Forbidden Game

episodes.synopsis: Crescent wakes up to find that Funny and Corona are gone, leaving him completely alone. In his depressed state, he cuts an imaginary version of himself out of his shadow.
episodes.title: Loneliness

episodes.synopsis: Crescent, Corona, and the owl rats steal a chocolate bar from Funny, but fight over who gets the last piece.
episodes.title: Chocolate

episodes.synopsis: Crescent and Corona finally find a way to fix their ship and go back home, leaving Funny in despair.
episodes.title: Going Home
